name: Excry
desc:
The world remembers nothing before the war. Neither does anyone in it.

Excry is a dark fantasy, faction-based experience where you, as one of the Fallen, must uncover what it means to be truly forgotten to be cast down, to leave behind everything you once were. The world is a shell of its former self, and you're sent on a journey to discover the reason for your descent while navigating an endless war.

One faction seeks absolute certainty through order. The other embraces chaos as revelation. But the conflict runs deeper than ideology and belief. Historical records contradict themselves. The past feels rewritten, or erased entirely.

Fight with hundreds of abilities across different weapon disciplines. Grow stronger through proficiency and unlock aptitudes that define your playstyle.  When you fall, you regress—forgetting who you are even more.

Choose from diverse races, each with unique variants and abilities. In a world built on lies, forge a truth that's yours alone.
